package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/examples/article/models"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/schema/ir"
)

type Other struct{}

var otherTitle = orm.NewStringField[Other](ir.Field{
	Name:   "title",
	GoName: "Title",
	Column: "title",
	Kind:   ir.FieldChar,
})

var _ = models.ArticleFields.Title.ExactField(orm.F(otherTitle))
